# Agatha Sowerby

## Overview

- **Age:** Over sixty  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** Widowed  <sub>[v1 c26 P0](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and community organizer  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Agatha Sowerby’s husband (applied to her husband)  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>; Mrs. Agatha  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P11](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby is a stout, heavy woman whose gait is described as a perpetual waddle. Her home sits by the ravine road in Brierley, where she keeps a vigilant watch over the neighborhood from her kitchen window.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v1 c22 P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000)_

## Personality

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby is an exceptionally proficient homemaker and community pillar who takes great pride in expressing her thoughts freely and keeping a vigilant watch over her neighbors' affairs. She is deeply inquisitive, direct to the point of bluntness, and known for voicing misgivings or disapproval when her counsel is not sought beforehand. Despite her severe demeanor and sharp tongue, she possesses a kindly, meddlesome heart that holds no lasting resentment once amends are made.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P22](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0022), [v1 c1 P24](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0024), [v1 c9 P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 c10 P33](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0033), [v1 c10 P38](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0038)_

## History

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby lived in Brierley at the slope of the ravine road, maintaining order and managing community organizations while keeping a watchful eye on all passersby. Upon learning that Obed and Thirza Abernethy intended to adopt an orphan boy, she immediately visited Grey Shutters to investigate and express her misgivings. When Obed instead brought home Nell Harcourt, Mrs. Agatha criticized the decision and later visited to inspect the child, only to be met with a passionate outburst from Nell after bluntly calling her plain and red-haired. Though initially offended, she forgave Nell completely when the girl offered a dramatic, humbling apology at her home, and she eventually grew quite fond of her. Throughout Nell's childhood and school years, Mrs. Agatha offered advice, attended community events like the Sunday-school picnic, and participated in political trips to Port Marlow. After the passing of her quiet husband, Thomas Sowerby, she faced financial hardship due to farm mortgages, leading her to move into Grey Shutters with Thirza Abernethy, where she set up her own quarters in the former spare room.

- Raised ten children and buried two  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
